content: A dominant theme of the Mafāḥiṣ's fourth section is the letter as coincidentia oppositorum (majmaʿ li-l-ṭarafayn wa-muʿtanaq li-l-mutaqābilayn): the letter alone can serve as matrix to the One, since only in the letter are opposites united, whereas every other existent is offset or relativized by its opposite.
